newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates widen in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates widen in quiet market.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight interbank rates widened on Wednesday in a quiet private sector market to between 10-3/8 and 11-1/2 percent from Tuesday's range of 10-7/16 and 11-1/4 percent, bankers said.

One banker quoted a range of 10-1/2 to 11-1/2 percent in a market with low supply. "So the guys who have the funds are playing around," he said. But other bankers quoted overnight rates at a narrower range of 10-3/8 to 10-1/2.
One week pound rates were 10-1/2, bankers said, compared to Tuesday's 10-5/8 and 11-1/8 percent.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
